en:a boy, his family, and one drink too: A boy, his family, and one drink too many.
en:a budu and ta buduna are the same wor: A budu and ta buduna are the same word with different fronts. A at the front means I. Ta at the front means YOU. That one letter is what this whole surah is about.
A clever hare beat a strong elephant.
en:a house with no door. what is it?: A house with no door. What is it?
en:a lam tara. there is a whole question: A lam tara. There is a whole question hiding in the first letter. That little a at the front means did you? And lam right behind it means not. Did you not see?
en:a little hare said: i will go to them: A little hare said: I will go to them.
en:a man said: this is cruel to the donk: A man said: this is cruel to the donkey!
en:a man said: where are the boy’s manne: A man said: where are the boy’s manners?
en:a man said: why do you not ride?: A man said: why do you not ride?
A mind is stronger than strength.
en:a monkey lived in a fig tree on the r: A monkey lived in a fig tree on the river bank.
en:a oodhu begins with a. that a at the: A oodhu begins with a. That a at the front means I. Remember na budu, where na at the front meant we? Same place, different person. Here it is one child asking.
en:a proper joke, and children tell this: A proper joke, and children tell this one in Arabic and in English. Qala means he said. Lil-jidar means to the wall.
en:a riddle. bila means without. a house: A riddle. Bila means without. A house with no door at all — what could it possibly be?
A small friend helps a great deal.
en:a taynaaka. there are two people hidi: A taynaaka. There are two people hiding in that one word. Naa means we, and ka on the end means you. We gave you.
en:a tortoise lived in a pond with two d: A tortoise lived in a pond with two ducks.
en:aamanoo and amiloo both end in oo. th: Aamanoo and amiloo both end in oo. That oo means THEY did it, lots of them, not just one person.
en:abadtum. now the you has moved to the: Abadtum. Now the you has moved to the END, as tum, and there it means you already did it, finished. Front for happening now, back for done.
Adam and Maryam are in the house.
Adam and Maryam are in the kitchen.
en:adam said: i did not eat the bread!: Adam said: I did not eat the bread!
en:adam said: i want the chocolate!: Adam said: I want the chocolate!
en:adam said: in your name, o allah, i d: Adam said: in Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
en:adam said: where is my shoe?: Adam said: where is my shoe?
en:adam stood up and ate the last piece: Adam stood up and ate the last piece of bread.
en:adam went with his mother to the mark: Adam went with his mother to the market.
en:after food i say: all praise is for a: After food I say: all praise is for Allah.
en:again there is no is. the moon… beaut: Again there is no is. The moon… beautiful. That is a whole sentence in Arabic.
en:al hamdu lillah. the lam inside lilla: Al hamdu lillah. The lam inside lillahi means for. Every good thing there is, is for Allah.
en:al kaafiroona ends in oona. you met t: Al kaafiroona ends in oona. You met that ending in yadkhuloona: many people, and they are the ones doing it.
en:al khannaas has a shadda on the n, so: Al khannaas has a shadda on the n, so you hold it: khan naas. Holding a letter often means doing the thing over and over. He hides, and hides, and hides again.
en:alayhim means on them. that him on th: Alayhim means on them. That him on the end is the them. In Arabic the endings carry an enormous amount of the meaning.
en:all praise is for allah, the lord of: All praise is for Allah, the Lord of everything there is.
en:allah, who needs nobody, and everybod: Allah, who needs nobody, and everybody needs Him.
en:an naffaathaat. the aat on the end me: An naffaathaat. The aat on the end means lots of them, and they are all women. One ending, and you already know how many people the ayah is talking about.
en:ana means i. there is no word for am,: Ana means I. There is no word for am, so two words make a whole sentence.
en:ana plus one word says how you are or: Ana plus one word says how you are or where you are. If the word will not come, use the English one. Ana hungry. Keep talking.
en:and for the first time ever, they agr: And for the first time ever, they agreed about something.
en:and from the bad in the dark when it: and from the bad in the dark when it comes,
en:and from the bad of a jealous person: and from the bad of a jealous person when he is jealous.
en:and from the bad of the people who bl: and from the bad of the people who blow on knots,
en:and he made them like straw that has: and He made them like straw that has been eaten up.
en:and he sent birds against them, flock: And He sent birds against them, flock after flock,
en:and his wife as well, the one who car: and his wife as well, the one who carried the firewood,
en:and i am never going to worship what: and I am never going to worship what you worship,
en:and in the middle of the river he sai: And in the middle of the river he said: my wife needs your heart to be healed!
en:and in the morning they said: all pra: And in the morning they said: all praise is for Allah.
en:and one day it was a little hare’s tu: And one day it was a little hare’s turn.
And the crow is on top of the house.
And the crow took the bread.
And there is nobody at all like Him.
en:and they told each other to be patien: and they told each other to be patient
en:and this is a playful monkey!: And this is a playful monkey!
en:and you are never going to worship wh: and you are never going to worship what I worship.
en:and you do not worship what i worship: and you do not worship what I worship,
en:and you see people coming into the re: and you see people coming into the religion of Allah in crowds,
Another old one. Asnaan means teeth. What has teeth, but never eats anything at all?
en:antum means you, and more than one of: Antum means you, and more than one of you. Arabic has a different word for one person and for a crowd, and it never mixes them up.
en:arabic has no verb for to have. indee: Arabic has no verb for to have. Indee really means at me. So: at me, a book. Baba learned this one in his class too.
en:arabic has no word for is. you just s: Arabic has no word for is. You just say: this… Baba. Two words, and you are done.
en:at amahum, and then aamanahum. hum on: At amahum, and then aamanahum. Hum on the end of both words means them. He fed them, He kept them safe, and the them is stuck onto the back of the word each time.
en:awraaq means leaves — and in arabic,: Awraaq means leaves — and in Arabic, just like in English, the pages of a book are called leaves too. That is the whole trick.
en:ayna means where. put it first, and t: Ayna means where. Put it first, and the whole sentence becomes a question.
Baba and Maryam are in the house.
en:baba came with the ladder, and he is: Baba came with the ladder, and he is not happy.
Baba put a cake on the table.
en:because quraysh are used to their jou: Because Quraysh are used to their journeys,
en:before food i say: in the name of all: Before food I say: in the name of Allah.
en:before sleep i say: in your name, o a: Before sleep I say: in Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
en:bi rabbi. there is that same little b: Bi rabbi. There is that same little bi you met in bismillah, and it does the same thing: it means with, and it pulls the next word to end in ee. Rabbu becomes rabbi.
en:bismi means with the name. that littl: Bismi means with the name. That little bi at the front means with, and it changes the ending of the next word to ee. Listen: bismi, not bismu.
en:both holes are yours. make the animal: Both holes are yours. Make the animal as silly as you can, and use an English word whenever you need one. Qala the crocodile: ureedu chips!
en:caught in a net, and let out by the s: Caught in a net, and let out by the smallest animal in the story.
en:did he not make their plan go all wro: Did He not make their plan go all wrong?
en:did you not see what your lord did to: Did you not see what your Lord did to the people of the elephant?
en:episode 1. a father, a son, and a ver: Episode 1. A father, a son, and a very confused donkey.
en:episode 1. lulu has bread. lulu had b: Episode 1. Lulu has bread. Lulu had bread.
Episode 2. A plan. A very bad plan.
en:episode 3. the crow talks. that is so: Episode 3. The crow talks. That is somehow worse.
en:episode 3. the house is sold. one nai: Episode 3. The house is sold. One nail is not.
en:episode 4. a truce. it lasts four lin: Episode 4. A truce. It lasts four lines.
en:episode 5. lulu learns something abou: Episode 5. Lulu learns something about trees.
en:episode 6. somebody finally wins. it: Episode 6. Somebody finally wins. It is not either of them.
en:episode 7. cake on the table. what co: Episode 7. Cake on the table. What could go wrong?
en:episode 8. a box, a rope, and a cat i: Episode 8. A box, a rope, and a cat inside.
en:everybody is somewhere. lulu is somew: Everybody is somewhere. Lulu is somewhere else.
en:everyone in the village laughed a lot: Everyone in the village laughed a lot.
en:exactly the same fee you already know: Exactly the same fee you already know. Only now there is an elephant in the living room. Silly sentences stick in your head far better than sensible ones.
en:except the ones who believe, and do g: Except the ones who believe, and do good, and tell each other the truth, and tell each other to be patient.
en:fa ja alahum. fa at the front means a: Fa ja alahum. Fa at the front means and then, straight away. Not later. It is the fastest little word in Arabic.
en:fa sabbih is an order again: praise!: Fa sabbih is an order again: praise! And in innahu, the hu on the end means he.
en:fa salli. salli is an order, so it is: Fa salli. Salli is an order, so it is short and it starts straight in. Pray!
en:fal ya budoo. that tiny la tucked ins: Fal ya budoo. That tiny la tucked inside means LET THEM. It is an order, but aimed at people who are not here. And the oo on the end is them, many of them.
en:fawqa means on top of. its opposite i: Fawqa means on top of. Its opposite is tahta, which means underneath.
en:fawqa means on top of. lulu does this: Fawqa means on top of. Lulu does this to Baba every single day, so it is worth knowing the word.
en:fee means in. put fee between two thi: Fee means in. Put fee between two things and you have said where something is.
en:for a girl, or a girl cat, this chang: For a girl, or a girl cat, this changes from hadha to hadhihi. Same word, a girl ending.
en:from anything bad in everything he ma: from anything bad in everything He made,
en:from the bad of the whisperer who hid: from the bad of the whisperer who hides away,
from the jinn, and from people.
en:ghaasiqin. hear the little n right at: Ghaasiqin. Hear the little n right at the end? That n means A dark night. Any dark night, not one special one.
Guide us along the straight path.
en:haasid and hasada are the same three: Haasid and hasada are the same three letters. Hasada is the doing. Stretch the first bit into haaa and it turns into the PERSON who does it. Arabic makes people out of doings that way.
en:hal indaka, and then anything. hal in: Hal indaka, and then anything. Hal indaka scissors? It works, and asking is always better than staying quiet.
en:hal is not a word you translate. put: Hal is not a word you translate. Put it at the front and the sentence simply becomes a question.
en:he befriended a crocodile and threw s: He befriended a crocodile and threw sweet figs down to him.
en:he did not have a child, and he was n: He did not have a child, and He was not born.
en:he jumped at him, and fell into the w: He jumped at him, and fell into the water.
en:he said to the elephant: i am the mes: He said to the elephant: I am the messenger of the moon!
en:he touched the water, and the moon mo: He touched the water, and the moon moved.
en:he was invited for dinner. he was mea: He was invited for dinner. He was meant to BE dinner.
en:he will burn in a fire full of flames: He will burn in a fire full of flames,
Here there is a little water.
en:his money and everything he earned di: His money and everything he earned did not help him at all.
en:his mother bought bread, fish and app: His mother bought bread, fish and apples.
en:his mother laughed and said: oh, adam: His mother laughed and said: oh, Adam!
en:his mother said: no, that is too much: His mother said: no, that is too much sugar.
How are you? To a girl.
en:i ask to be kept safe: I ask to be kept safe
I do not have a ball.
I do not have a book.
en:i do not worship what you worship,: I do not worship what you worship,
en:idha means when. not if, but when. it: Idha means when. Not if, but when. It is going to happen.
en:ihdinaa. now the naa is at the end, a: Ihdinaa. Now the naa is at the END, and there it means us. Guide us. The same little naa, in a different place, doing a different job.
en:ilaafihim. the him on the end means t: Ilaafihim. The him on the end means their. It is the same little him you met at the end of alayhim in Al Fatiha.
Imra atuhu. Hu on the end means his. You heard hu meaning he in innahu; stuck onto a thing it means his. His wife.
en:in the forest there was a big lion wh: In the forest there was a big lion who ate the animals every day.
en:in the kitchen there is only one piec: In the kitchen there is only one piece of bread.
en:in the morning i say: all praise is f: In the morning I say: all praise is for Allah.
en:in unity there is strength and safety: In unity there is strength and safety.
en:indee, and then the thing. an english: Indee, and then the thing. An English word in the hole is fine. Indee bicycle. Say it now, and learn the Arabic word later.
en:inna al insaana. insaan ends in a her: Inna al insaana. Insaan ends in a here only because inna is sitting in front of it. A little word in front changes the ending behind.
en:is lulu in the box? no!: Is Lulu in the box? No!
en:is lulu on the chair? no!: Is Lulu on the chair? No!
en:is lulu under the bed? no!: Is Lulu under the bed? No!
en:it cries without eyes. what is it?: It cries without eyes. What is it?
It has a door and does not see.
It has a house and does not eat.
en:it has an eye and does not see. what: It has an eye and does not see. What is it?
It has an eye and does not sleep.
It has an eye and it does not see.
It has doors and is not a plant.
It has leaves and is not a book.
en:it has leaves and is not a plant. wha: It has leaves and is not a plant. What is it?
It has leaves and it is not a plant.
It has teeth and does not drink.
en:it has teeth and does not eat. what i: It has teeth and does not eat. What is it?
It has teeth and it does not eat.
en:it is the one who hates you who is cu: It is the one who hates you who is cut off.
en:it took the bread and flew off!: It took the bread and flew off!
It writes and does not eat.
en:it writes and does not read. what is: It writes and does not read. What is it?
It writes and does not sleep.
It writes and it does not read.
en:iyyaka na budu. the na at the start o: Iyyaka na budu. The na at the START of na budu means WE. Not I worship. We worship, all of us together.
en:jeedihaa. haa on the end means her. y: Jeedihaa. Haa on the end means her. You have just had hu for his, and now haa for her. Two small sounds, and you know who the ayah means.
en:juha and his son carried the donkey!: Juha and his son carried the donkey!
Juha and his son rode on the donkey.
en:juha and his son walked with the donk: Juha and his son walked with the donkey.
Juha came every day to see his nail.
Juha got down and only his son rode.
en:juha hung an old fish on the nail!: Juha hung an old fish on the nail!
en:juha laughed and got his house back a: Juha laughed and got his house back again.
en:juha poured the soup into his coat!: Juha poured the soup into his coat!
en:juha said: this nail in the wall belo: Juha said: this nail in the wall belongs only to me.
en:juha sold his house to a man in the m: Juha sold his house to a man in the market.
en:juha went back and put on a fine coat: Juha went back and put on a fine coat.
Juha went to a big feast.
en:kaydahum. you have met hum meaning th: Kaydahum. You have met hum meaning them. Stuck onto a thing instead of a person, it means THEIR. Their plan.
en:kayfa means how. this is the question: Kayfa means how. This is the question you will say more often than any other in your whole life.
en:khalaqa ends in a. that a at the end: Khalaqa ends in a. That a at the end means HE did it, and he finished doing it. Everything He made is already made.
en:lakum deenukum wa liya deeni. kum on: Lakum deenukum wa liya deeni. Kum on the end means your. Ee on the end means my. Two tiny endings carry the whole ayah.
en:lam yalid. that little lam in front t: Lam yalid. That little lam in front turns the whole thing into DID NOT. He did not have a child.
en:limadha means why. it is madha, what,: Limadha means why. It is madha, what, with a li stuck on the front. Ask it about anything at all.
en:listen carefully: you say as samad, n: Listen carefully: you say as Samad, not al Samad. The lam vanishes into the s. That happens with some letters and not others.
en:look at ilaahi an naasi, then listen: Look at ilaahi an naasi, then listen to it: ilaahin naas. The lam disappears into the n, just like al Samad became as Samad. Some letters swallow the lam.
en:lulu climbed, and climbed, and climbe: Lulu climbed, and climbed, and climbed.
en:lulu is a girl, so small gets a girl: Lulu is a girl, so small gets a girl ending — a soft ah sound at the end. Listen for it: sagheerah.
en:lulu is here! lulu is on top of baba!: Lulu is here! Lulu is on top of Baba!
en:lulu is on top of baba!: Lulu is on top of Baba!
en:lulu is on top of mama!: Lulu is on top of Mama!
en:lulu is on top of the book!: Lulu is on top of the book!
Lulu is on top of the book.
Lulu is on top of the door.
en:lulu jumped and the crow flew at the: Lulu jumped and the crow flew at the same moment.
en:lulu looked at the crow one more time: Lulu looked at the crow one more time.
en:lulu looked at the crow, and the crow: Lulu looked at the crow, and the crow looked at Lulu.
en:lulu placed a small box in the garden: Lulu placed a small box in the garden.
en:lulu pulled the rope quickly and the: Lulu pulled the rope quickly and the box fell on her!
en:lulu remained inside the box by herse: Lulu remained inside the box by herself.
en:lulu said: i want a fish: Lulu said: I want a fish
en:lulu said: that is my bread!: Lulu said: that is MY bread!
en:lulu saw the crow at the top of the t: Lulu saw the crow at the top of the tall tree.
en:lulu was there, and she had the bread: Lulu was there, and she had the bread!
en:maa aghnaa. maa at the front turns it: Maa aghnaa. Maa at the front turns it into DID NOT. Lam did that job in Al Ikhlas; maa does it too. Arabic has more than one way to say no.
en:maaliki yawmi ad deen. owner, of the: Maaliki yawmi ad deen. Owner, of the day, of the judging. Three words leaning on each other, and each one ends in ee because of it.
en:madha fee. what is in. the answer sho: Madha fee. What is in. The answer should be bread or water. It is not.
en:madha means what. ask it, and let the: Madha means what. Ask it, and let the other person fill in the rest.
en:maliki. it ends in ee for exactly the: Maliki. It ends in ee for exactly the reason maaliki did in Al Fatiha: it is leaning on the word after it. King, of the people.
en:mama said no to the chocolate. mama b: Mama said no to the chocolate. Mama bought the chocolate.
en:mama said: come on, to the masjid!: Mama said: come on, to the masjid!
en:mama said: where is the bread?: Mama said: where is the bread?
en:man means who. it asks about a person: Man means who. It asks about a person, and ayna asks about a place.
en:maryam said: and i read, say he is al: Maryam said: and I read, say He is Allah, the One.
en:min turned into mina here, with an a: Min turned into mina here, with an a on the end, only to make it easy to say before the next word. Arabic bends its words a little so the ayah runs smoothly.
en:needs nobody, and everybody needs him: needs nobody, and everybody needs Him
en:night came, and adam and maryam went: Night came, and Adam and Maryam went to bed.
en:no! lulu is on top of baba!: No! Lulu is on top of Baba!
No! Lulu is under the table.
Nobody did it. Somebody did it.
en:now lulu is up the tree and cannot ge: Now Lulu is up the tree and cannot get down.
en:one bird is caught. a hundred birds f: One bird is caught. A hundred birds flying together are free.
en:people saw her and said: look! a flyi: People saw her and said: look! A flying tortoise!
en:put anything at all in the front hole: Put anything at all in the front hole and see how silly you can make it. English is allowed. Dinosaur fee al-bayt!
en:put ma in front of it and the whole t: Put ma in front of it and the whole thing turns into a no. Ma indee: not at me.
en:qala adam: i want my bike: qala Adam: I want my bike
en:qala is he said. qalat is she said, w: Qala is he said. Qalat is she said, with one little t on the end for a girl. Now you can tell anybody what anybody said.
Qala, then who, then what they said. Anything can go in the second hole, English included. Qala Adam: I want my bike.
en:quick thinking saves a person from ru: Quick thinking saves a person from ruin.
en:qul means say. it is an order, and it: Qul means SAY. It is an order, and it is only three letters long.
en:sa yaslaa. that sa stuck on the front: Sa yaslaa. That sa stuck on the front means it is GOING to happen, later. One letter, and the word moves into the future.
Say: He is Allah, the One.
en:say: i ask the lord of the morning li: Say: I ask the Lord of the morning light to keep me safe,
en:say: i ask the lord of the people to: Say: I ask the Lord of the people to keep me safe,
en:say: o you who do not believe,: Say: O you who do not believe,
en:shaani aka. there is that ka again on: Shaani aka. There is that ka again on the end, and here it means your. The one who dislikes you.
en:she said: today i am getting my bread: She said: today I am getting my bread back!
en:she tied a rope to the box and waited: She tied a rope to the box and waited behind the tree.
en:she was told not to say a word. she s: She was told not to say a word. She said a word.
en:so let them worship the lord of this: so let them worship the Lord of this House,
So pray to your Lord, and give.
Tap a word to hear it.
en:tarmeehim starts with ta. that ta at: Tarmeehim starts with ta. That ta at the front means SHE is doing it, right now, while you watch. A flock of birds is a she in Arabic.
en:the animals said: we will send you on: The animals said: we will send you one every day, and leave us alone.
en:the biggest animal there is, frighten: The biggest animal there is, frightened by something that is not there.
The book is on the table.
The book is under the table.
en:the bunny and the monkey laughed!: The bunny and the monkey laughed!
en:the bunny runs after the monkey!: The bunny runs after the monkey!
en:the chocolate was in the bag!: The chocolate was in the bag!
en:the collared dove came with her compa: The collared dove came with her companions and they fell into the net.
en:the collared dove said: let no one fl: The collared dove said: let no one fly alone, but let us all fly together!
en:the crocodile said: come to my house: The crocodile said: come to my house on the island to see my family.
The crow ate the entire cake.
en:the crow came and stood on top of the: The crow came and stood on top of the box laughing!
en:the crow came and took the cake!: The crow came and took the cake!
The crow came in through the door.
The crow flew into the sky happily.
The crow flew out of the door.
The crow flew over the water.
The crow is under the door.
en:the crow looked at her and flew to th: The crow looked at her and flew to the other tree.
en:the crow said: i love bread!: The crow said: I love bread!
The crow said: it WAS your bread.
The crow said: let us be friends.
The crow said: yes! This is for you.
en:the describing word comes after the t: The describing word comes AFTER the thing in Arabic, the opposite way round from English. Not the big elephant, but the elephant the big.
en:the elephant is in the house: The elephant is in the house
en:the elephant is in the house!: The elephant is in the house!
en:the elephant is in the kitchen!: The elephant is in the kitchen!
en:the elephant is in the room!: The elephant is in the room!
en:the elephant looked in the water and: The elephant looked in the water and saw the moon.
The elephant looked into the water.
en:the elephant said: i want a book!: The elephant said: I want a book!
en:the elephant said: i want juice!: The elephant said: I want juice!
en:the elephant said: i want water: The elephant said: I want water
en:the elephant said: i want water!: The elephant said: I want water!
en:the elephant was frightened and went: The elephant was frightened and went far away.
en:the elephants came to the spring wher: The elephants came to the spring where the hares drink.
The elephants drank the whole spring. One hare sent them home.
en:the hands of abu lahab will be ruined: The hands of Abu Lahab will be ruined, and he is ruined.
en:the hare came late, and the lion beca: The hare came late, and the lion became very angry.
en:the hare said: there is another lion: The hare said: there is another lion in the well and he took my food!
en:the honor is for you, not me!: The honor is for you, not me!
en:the hunter set his net and scattered: The hunter set his net and scattered grain over it.
en:the lion looked into the well and saw: The lion looked into the well and saw a lion looking back at him.
en:the little hare went back, and all th: The little hare went back, and all the animals were happy.
en:the man agreed and lived in the new h: The man agreed and lived in the new house.
en:the man became angry, left the house: The man became angry, left the house to Juha, and ran away.
en:the monkey ate a banana and gave the: The monkey ate a banana and gave the carrot.
The monkey has a big banana.
en:the monkey said: i left my heart up i: The monkey said: I left my heart up in the tree, let us go back to get it!
en:the moon is angry, because you drank: The moon is angry, because you drank his water.
en:the moon is in the house: The moon is in the house
The Most Kind, the Most Merciful.
The mouse cut through the net.
en:the one who whispers inside the heart: the one who whispers inside the hearts of people,
en:the ones you were angry with: the ones You were angry with
The Owner of the Day of Judgement.
en:the path of the people you were kind: The path of the people You were kind to, not the people who made You angry, and not the people who got lost.
en:the pond dried up, and the two ducks: The pond dried up, and the two ducks said: we are going to another water.
en:the same two names again, ar rahman a: The same two names again, ar Rahman ar Raheem. Arabic repeats things on purpose, so that they sink in.
en:the smallest animal in the forest has: The smallest animal in the forest has the biggest idea.
en:the tortoise opened her mouth to answ: The tortoise opened her mouth to answer them.
en:the tortoise said: take me with you!: The tortoise said: take me with you!
en:the words they already know, said at: The words they already know, said at the right moment.
en:their journey in the winter and their: their journey in the winter and their journey in the summer,
en:their mother said: what do we say bef: Their mother said: what do we say before sleep?
en:then praise your lord and ask him to: then praise your Lord and ask Him to forgive you. He always turns back to you.
There is bread on the table.
There was no moon there at all.
They came down onto some grain.
en:they carried a stick, the tortoise he: They carried a stick, the tortoise held it in her mouth, and they flew.
en:they crashed over the table and fell: They crashed over the table and fell on the floor.
en:they drank all the water and broke ev: They drank all the water and broke everything.
en:they pulled up the net with their win: They pulled up the net with their wings and flew into the sky like one bird.
They read together, then they slept.
en:they returned to the shore and the mo: They returned to the shore and the monkey jumped into the tree and was saved.
en:they said to her: do not speak, ever!: They said to her: do not speak, ever!
en:they went home and adam opened the ba: They went home and Adam opened the bag.
en:they went to a friendly rat who cut t: They went to a friendly rat who cut the net with his teeth.
en:this ayah does not finish. li ilaafi: This ayah does not finish. Li ilaafi means because of, and then it stops and waits. You have to go all the way to ayah three to find out what happens because of it.
en:this ayah is exactly the same as ayah: This ayah is exactly the same as ayah three, word for word. Arabic repeats things on purpose. Saying it twice is how you say: I really mean it.
en:this is a real arabic riddle, and chi: This is a real Arabic riddle, and children have been asking each other this one for hundreds of years. Lahu means it has. Think before you tap!
en:this is the best one. ureedu, and the: This is the best one. Ureedu, and then anything. You do not know the Arabic for pen? Say ureedu pen. That is a real sentence and everybody will understand it.
en:throwing stones of hard baked clay at: throwing stones of hard baked clay at them,
Today Adam is in the house.
en:two things and a fee in the middle. e: Two things and a fee in the middle. Either hole can be an English word if you are stuck — Lulu fee garden works perfectly.
Two things you know, stuck together. Qala for he said, then ureedu for what he wanted. Animals can say anything you like.
en:uhibbu means i love. the little mark: Uhibbu means I love. The little mark doubles the b, so you hold it a moment: u hib bu.
en:uhibbu, and then whoever or whatever: Uhibbu, and then whoever or whatever you love. Uhibbu chocolate is a perfectly good sentence.
en:ureedu means i want. it is one of the: Ureedu means I want. It is one of the most useful words there is, because you can ask for anything at all with it.
en:wa arsala. one word that means and he: Wa arsala. One word that means AND He sent. The and is a single letter, glued to the front. Arabic loves to do that.
en:wa means and, and it sticks onto the: Wa means and, and it sticks onto the front of the next word instead of standing alone.
en:wal asr. this wa is not the and you k: Wal asr. This wa is not the and you know. Here it is a promise word, like saying: by the time!
en:walam yakun. the same lam doing the s: Walam yakun. The same lam doing the same job. And ahad on the end means one, or anyone at all.
We have given you so much good.
en:what did the boy say to the wall?: What did the boy say to the wall?
en:what did the elephant say to the wall: What did the elephant say to the wall?
en:what did the wall say to the wall?: What did the wall say to the wall?
en:when the help of allah comes, and the: When the help of Allah comes, and the winning,
en:who fed them so they are not hungry,: who fed them so they are not hungry, and kept them safe so they are not afraid.
en:whoever does not listen to good advic: Whoever does not listen to good advice falls.
en:with a rope of twisted fibre around h: with a rope of twisted fibre around her neck.
en:with, or by, the name of allah, the m: With, or by, the name of Allah, the Most Kind, the Most Merciful.
en:yabki means it cries. something up in: Yabki means it cries. Something up in the sky cries all over you and has no eyes at all.
en:yadaa means two hands. not one hand,: Yadaa means two hands. Not one hand, not lots of hands. Arabic has an ending it uses only when there are exactly two of something.
en:yadkhuloona ends in oona. that ending: Yadkhuloona ends in oona. That ending means they are doing it right now, and there are many of them.
en:yaktub means it writes. yaqra means i: Yaktub means it writes. Yaqra means it reads. Something writes all day long and has never read a single word.
en:you alone we worship, and you alone w: You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help.
en:you already know ureedu. now ask for: You already know ureedu. Now ask for something ridiculous with it. The answer will be no, but the sentence is perfect.
en:you can point at anything and say had: You can point at anything and say hadha. If you do not know the Arabic word yet, say the English one — hadha pen. People understand you, and that is what matters.
en:you have your religion, and i have mi: You have your religion, and I have mine.
en:you know ayna already. the answer is: You know ayna already. The answer is funny because you have SEEN it: Lulu sits on Baba in the books, and he keeps telling her he is not a table.
en:yuwaswisu. say it out loud. the word: Yuwaswisu. Say it out loud. The word sounds like the thing it means: a whisper, going on and on. Arabic makes words out of sounds.
اصطدما فوق المائده ووقعا علي الارض: اِصْطَدَمَا فَوْقَ الْمَائِدَةِ وَوَقَعَا عَلَى الْأَرْضِ.
الان لولو فوق الشجره ولا تستطيع النزول: الْآنَ لُولُو فَوْقَ الشَّجَرَةِ وَلَا تَسْتَطِيعُ النُّزُولَ.
باع جحا بيته الي رجل في السوق: بَاعَ جُحَا بَيْتَهُ إِلَى رَجُلٍ فِي السُّوقِ.
تاخر الارنب فغضب الاسد غضبا شديدا: تَأَخَّرَ الْأَرْنَبُ فَغَضِبَ الْأَسَدُ غَضَبًا شَدِيدًا.
جاء الغراب ووقف فوق الصندوق يضحك: جَاءَ الْغُرَابُ وَوَقَفَ فَوْقَ الصُّنْدُوقِ يَضْحَكُ!
جاء بابا بالسلم وهو ليس سعيدا: جَاءَ بَابَا بِالسُّلَّمِ، وَهُوَ لَيْسَ سَعِيدًا.
جاء جحا كل يوم ليري مسماره: جَاءَ جُحَا كُلَّ يَوْمٍ لِيَرَى مِسْمَارَهُ.
جاءت الحمامه المطوقه مع صاحباتها فوقعن ف: جَاءَتِ الْحَمَامَةُ الْمُطَوَّقَةُ مَعَ صَاحِبَاتِهَا فَوَقَعْنَ فِي الشَّبَكَةِ.
جفت البركه فقالت البطتان سنذهب الي ماء ا: جَفَّتِ الْبِرْكَةُ فَقَالَتِ الْبَطَّتَانِ: سَنَذْهَبُ إِلَى مَاءٍ آخَرَ.
حسن التصرف ينقذ صاحبه من الهلاك: حُسْنُ التَّصَرُّفِ يُنْقِذُ صَاحِبَهُ مِنَ الْهَلَاكِ.
حملتا عودا وامسكته السلحفاه بفمها وطارتا: حَمَلَتَا عُودًا وَأَمْسَكَتْهُ السُّلَحْفَاةُ بِفَمِهَا وَطَارَتَا.
ذهب ادم مع امه الي السوق: ذَهَبَ أَدَم مَعَ أُمِّهِ إِلَى السُّوقِ.
ذهبن الي جرذ صديق فقطع الشبكه باسنانه: ذَهَبْنَ إِلَى جُرَذٍ صَدِيقٍ فَقَطَعَ الشَّبَكَةَ بِأَسْنَانِهِ.
رات لولو الغراب فوق الشجره الطويله: رَأَتْ لُولُو الْغُرَاب فَوْقَ الشَّجَرَةِ الطَّوِيلَةِ.
راها الناس وقالوا انظروا سلحفاه تطير: رَآهَا النَّاسُ وَقَالُوا: اُنْظُرُوا! سُلَحْفَاةٌ تَطِيرُ!
ربطت حبلا بالصندوق وانتظرت خلف الشجره: رَبَطَتْ حَبْلًا بِالصُّنْدُوقِ وَانْتَظَرَتْ خَلْفَ الشَّجَرَةِ.
رجع الارنب الصغير وفرحت الحيوانات كلها: رَجَعَ الْأَرْنَبُ الصَّغِيرُ وَفَرِحَتِ الْحَيَوَانَاتُ كُلُّهَا.
رجعا الي البيت وفتح ادم الحقيبه: رَجَعَا إِلَى الْبَيْتِ وَفَتَحَ أَدَم الْحَقِيبَةَ.
رجعا الي الشاطئ فقفز القرد فوق الشجره ون: رَجَعَا إِلَى الشَّاطِئِ فَقَفَزَ الْقِرْدُ فَوْقَ الشَّجَرَةِ وَنَجَا.
سحبت لولو الحبل بسرعه فوقع الصندوق عليها: سَحَبَتْ لُولُو الْحَبْلَ بِسُرْعَةٍ فَوَقَعَ الصُّنْدُوقُ عَلَيْهَا!
شربت كل الماء وكسرت كل شيء: شَرِبَتْ كُلَّ المَاء وَكَسَرَتْ كُلَّ شَيْء.
صادق تمساحا وكان يرمي له من التين الحلو: صَادَقَ تِمْسَاحًا وَكَانَ يَرْمِي لَهُ مِنَ التِّينِ الْحُلْوِ.
ضحك جحا واخذ بيته من جديد: ضَحِكَ جُحَا وَأَخَذَ بَيْتَهُ مِنْ جَدِيدٍ.
علق جحا سمكه قديمه علي المسمار: عَلَّقَ جُحَا سَمَكَةً قَدِيمَةً عَلَى الْمِسْمَارِ!
غضب الرجل وترك البيت لجحا وهرب: غَضِبَ الرَّجُلُ وَتَرَكَ الْبَيْتَ لِجُحَا وَهَرَبَ.
قال ادم باسمك اللهم اموت واحيا: قَالَ أَدَم: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا.
قال الارنب في البئر اسد اخر اخذ طعامي: قَالَ الْأَرْنَبُ: فِي الْبِئْرِ أَسَدٌ آخَرُ أَخَذَ طَعَامِي!
قال التمساح تعال الي بيتي في الجزيره لتر: قَالَ التِّمْسَاحُ: تَعَالَ إِلَى بَيْتِي فِي الْجَزِيرَةِ لِتَرَى أَهْلِي.
قال القرد تركت قلبي فوق الشجره فلنرجع لن: قَالَ الْقِرْدُ: تَرَكْتُ قَلْبِي فَوْقَ الشَّجَرَةِ، فَلْنَرْجِعْ لِنَأْخُذَهُ!
قال جحا هذا المسمار في الحائط لي فقط: قَالَ جُحَا: هَذَا الْمِسْمَارُ فِي الْحَائِطِ لِي فَقَط.
قالت الحيوانات نرسل لك واحدا كل يوم واتر: قَالَتِ الْحَيَوَانَاتُ: نُرْسِلُ لَكَ وَاحِدًا كُلَّ يَوْمٍ وَاتْرُكْنَا.
قالت المطوقه لا تطر كل واحده وحدها بل نط: قَالَتِ الْمُطَوَّقَةُ: لَا تَطِرْ كُلُّ وَاحِدَةٍ وَحْدَهَا، بَلْ نَطِيرُ جَمِيعًا مَعًا!
قالت امهما ماذا نقول قبل النوم: قَالَتْ أُمُّهُمَا: مَاذَا نَقُولُ قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ؟
قالت مريم واقرا قل هو الله احد: قَالَتْ مَرْيَم: وَأَقْرَأُ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ.
قفزت لولو وطار الغراب في نفس الوقت: قَفَزَتْ لُولُو وَطَارَ الْغُرَابُ فِي نَفْسِ الْوَقْتِ.
قلعن الشبكه باجنحتهن وطرن في السماء كطائ: قَلَعْنَ الشَّبَكَةَ بِأَجْنِحَتِهِنَّ وَطِرْنَ فِي السَّمَاءِ كَطَائِرٍ وَاحِدٍ.
كان في الغابه اسد كبير ياكل الحيوانات كل: كَانَ فِي الْغَابَةِ أَسَدٌ كَبِيرٌ يَأْكُلُ الْحَيَوَانَاتِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
كان قرد يعيش فوق شجره تين علي شاطئ النهر: كَانَ قِرْدٌ يَعِيشُ فَوْقَ شَجَرَةِ تِينٍ عَلَى شَاطِئِ النَّهْرِ.
كانت سلحفاه تعيش في بركه مع بطتين: كَانَتْ سُلَحْفَاةٌ تَعِيشُ فِي بِرْكَةٍ مَعَ بَطَّتَيْنِ.
له اسنان ولا ياكل ما هو: لَهُ أَسْنَان وَلَا يَأْكُل. مَا هُوَ؟
له اوراق وليس نباتا ما هو: لَهُ أَوْرَاق وَلَيْسَ نَبَاتًا. مَا هُوَ؟
له عين ولا يري ما هو: لَهُ عَيْن وَلَا يَرَى. مَا هُوَ؟
نصب الصياد شبكته ونثر عليها الحب: نَصَبَ الصَّيَّادُ شَبَكَتَهُ وَنَثَرَ عَلَيْهَا الْحَبَّ.
نظر الاسد في البئر فراي اسدا ينظر اليه: نَظَرَ الْأَسَدُ فِي الْبِئْرِ فَرَأَى أَسَدًا يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ.
نظر الغراب اليها وطار الي الشجره الاخري: نَظَرَ الْغُرَاب إِلَيْهَا وَطَارَ إِلَى الشَّجَرَةِ الْأُخْرَى.
نظر الفيل في الماء فراي القمر: نَظَرَ الفِيل فِي المَاء فَرَأَى القَمَر.
نظرت لولو الي الغراب مره اخري: نَظَرَتْ لُولُو إِلَى الْغُرَابِ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى.
نظرت لولو الي الغراب ونظر الغراب الي لول: نَظَرَتْ لُولُو إِلَى الْغُرَابِ، وَنَظَرَ الْغُرَابُ إِلَى لُولُو.
وافق الرجل وسكن في البيت الجديد: وَافَقَ الرَّجُلُ وَسَكَنَ فِي الْبَيْتِ الْجَدِيدِ.
وضعت لولو صندوقا صغيرا في الحديقه: وَضَعَتْ لُولُو صُنْدُوقًا صَغِيرًا فِي الْحَدِيقَةِ.
وفي وسط النهر قال زوجتي تريد قلبك لتشفي: وَفِي وَسَطِ النَّهْرِ قَالَ: زَوْجَتِي تُرِيدُ قَلْبَكَ لِتَشْفَى!
وفي يوم جاء دور ارنب صغير: وَفِي يَوْمٍ جَاءَ دَوْرُ أَرْنَبٍ صَغِيرٍ.
